title: Performance Management
overview: Front-line managers play a pivotal role in any performance management system, which extends beyond merely setting objectives and conducting appraisals. This course offers an in-depth exploration of how to establish the right metrics to effectively manage employee performance, focusing on objective measures. It also covers the process of conducting impactful performance appraisal meetings and underscores the importance of coaching as a critical tool for enhancing employee performance.
audience: This course is ideal for team leaders, managers, business partners, and line managers responsible for overseeing the performance of their organization and its employees.
methodology: The course blends theoretical knowledge with practical applications, requiring participants to engage in role-playing exercises for performance appraisal meetings and coaching sessions.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Define performance management, its objectives, and key responsibilities
Outline the main phases of the performance management cycle and manage each for optimal results
Develop both tangible and intangible performance measures
Create business-focused objectives, including SMART targets, measures, and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Define coaching and outline the five steps for conducting effective coaching sessions
Conduct performance appraisal meetings with confidence and effectiveness
Identify methods for rewarding and recognizing employees
